gen.title: Recall of plutonium properties and reactor cycle

cards.stem: What is the atomic number of plutonium?
cards.quote: Plutonium is a radioactive metallic element with the atomic number 94.

cards.stem: Which plutonium isotope has been used to power batteries for heart pacemakers?
cards.quote: Plutonium-238 has been used to power batteries for some heart pacemakers, as well as provide a long-lived heat source to power NASA space missions.

cards.stem: Which of these is listed as a common plutonium isotope?
cards.quote: There are five “common” isotopes of plutonium, Pu-238, Pu-239, Pu-240, Pu-241, and Pu-242.

cards.stem: About how much plutonium by weight is found in spent fuel from United States reactors?
cards.quote: Spent nuclear fuel from U.S. reactors contains about 1 percent plutonium by weight.
